text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the shopping district, I heard the cheerful voices of children.
Standing right at the center was—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! You picked up this many?!
I can't lose to you! Time to get serious~☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wanna join in too? A 'litter pickup contest'!
We're competing to see who can pick up the most.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Look, people litter a lot around here, right?
It's bad for feng shui, so it's been bothering me.
I was picking it up by myself at first, but—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
You looked like you were having so much fun, Big Sis,
that I just had to join in! Right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey☆ Why don't you join in too!
Team up with me and let's pick up trash together!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right, it's settled! So, what kind of strategy should we go with?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wanna see how cool an Umamusume can be?☆
Leave the instructions to you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Take an aggressive position!
Next up is that corner over there!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you're so fast!
We're not gonna lose to you, though~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inspired by Copano Rickey, the children grew serious too, turning it into a heated showdown――!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
—We'll help out too!
—Here's some tea for everyone! Please help yourself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: To make others happy, you've gotta be happy yourself! Let's go out there bright, cheerful, and full of energy☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's all have fun, everyone☆
Smiling brings good fortune and happiness☆

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at you gives me energy, Big Sis~!
All right, time to try even harder~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Drawn in by Copano Rickey's smile, everyone around joined in picking up trash with smiles on their faces――

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
—We'll help out too!
—Here's some tea for everyone! Please help yourself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Cooperation! Refreshments too! Everyone, we got tea~☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hm? Come to think of it, you're right! To think so many would gather for this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This must be the result of so many people being drawn to
Copano Rickey's dedicated spirit of bringing smiles for others' happiness.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can feel the great flow of happy.
The power of happy really is amazing, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed completely oblivious to how amazing it was
that she had created that momentum all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right, I've had my break, so time for one more push! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Everyone together――

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Happy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the litter vanished from the shopping district,
replaced instead by radiant smiles on everyone's faces.
